Distance to escape terrain

dist_escape.Rd

Calculates the distance from each raster cell to the nearest cell meeting or exceeding a specified slope threshold, interpreted as escape terrain.

Usage

dist_escape(dem, escape_slope, maxdist = 4000)

Arguments

dem

A terra::SpatRaster representing elevation.

escape_slope

Numeric scalar giving the slope threshold in degrees.

maxdist

Numeric scalar giving the maximum distance (in map units, typically meters) over which to compute distance. Cells farther than maxdist from the nearest escape-terrain cell are returned as NA. Defaults to 4000 meters. Set to NA to compute distances without a cap.

Value

A terra::SpatRaster giving the distance in meters from each cell to the nearest escape-terrain cell. Cells beyond maxdist are NA.

Details

Slope is calculated from the input DEM using terra::terrain() with 8 neighbors and units in degrees. Cells with slope greater than or equal to escape_slope are treated as escape terrain.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(terra)

r <- rast(nrows = 100, ncols = 100, xmin = 0, xmax = 100, ymin = 0, ymax = 100)
values(r) <- runif(ncell(r), 0, 1000)

d <- dist_escape(r, escape_slope = 30)
names(d)
plot(d)
} # }
